title: Purple Mage Warrior
description: A young East Asian woman with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic combat pose. She holds a large ornate purple hammer in one hand and a glowing purple magical energy effect swirls around her other hand and a sheathed katana on her back.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female warrior with long dark hair tied in a topknot, wearing an orange cropped top with black tribal patterns, dark pants, and purple armored boots. She stands in a powerful combat stance holding a large ornate purple warhammer, with swirling purple magical energy emanating from her other hand. A katana is sheathed on her back. Dynamic fantasy character illustration, dramatic lighting, vibrant colors, detailed digital art
